resume: When it can be required (canteen, after-school care), what it covers, how to check your child is not already insured, and how to arrange it between separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: School insurance (assurance scolaire) protects your child during school activities and on the way to and from school. It combines two types of cover: civil liability (responsabilité civile), for damage the child causes to others, and personal accident insurance (individuelle accident corporel), for injuries the child suffers, even if they hurt themselves on their own. An "extra-scolaire" option also covers leisure activities and holidays, 24 hours a day.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of children in school, from nursery school to high school.
Parents whose child eats at the canteen or attends the town's after-school care, where a certificate may be required.
aSavoir: In principle, school insurance is optional, whether activities are compulsory (swimming pool or gym sessions on the timetable) or optional (outings and trips organized by the school).
It may be required for the canteen and for after-school activities organized by the town (supervised homework, cultural or sports activities).
Civil liability is often already included in your multi-risk home insurance (assurance multirisque habitation), and some personal policies cover personal injury: check before you take out a policy.
Possible additional cover depending on the policy: theft or extortion (racket), home tutoring for a child who is ill.
If your child changes school, let your insurer know.
Indicative cost according to service-public.gouv.fr: from about €10 per year per child.

etapes.titre: Separated parents: decide who insures the child
etapes.detail: There is no point paying twice for the same cover. One policy is enough if the child is properly named on it; share the certificate.

etapes.titre: Take out a policy if needed
etapes.detail: With the insurer of your choice, or through a group policy offered by a parents' association or a private school.

etapes.detail: Certificate in the child's name, for the current school year, mentioning civil liability and, if requested, personal accident cover.
To the school, the town hall (canteen, after-school care) or the holiday club if it is requested.
